claims.content: Allows the Auctioneer to edit or remove existing auctions from the system.

goal.raw_text: Allows the Auctioneer to edit or remove existing auctions from the system.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Admin Application.
The Auctioneer has navigated to the 'View / Edit Scheduled Auctions' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu.
At least one scheduled auction exists in the system that can be selected for editing or removal.
The Auctioneer selects an existing auction from the list on the 'View / Edit Scheduled Auctions' page and chooses to edit or remove it.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects an existing auction from the list on the 'View / Edit Scheduled Auctions' page and chooses to edit or remove it.

claims.content: The system displays a list of existing scheduled auctions with details such as Product ID, Description, Open Bid, Unit Cost, Duration, Starts, Ends, and Product Type.
The Auctioneer selects one or more auctions from the list by checking the corresponding 'Action' checkboxes.
The Auctioneer chooses an action from the 'Choose All' dropdown menu, such as 'Remove checked items from this auction' or 'Apply Duration to all'.
If editing, the Auctioneer may adjust parameters like 'Duration', 'Starts', 'Ends', or apply manual reserves using the 'Apply Manual Reserves to Selections' panel.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply' button to confirm changes to the selected auctions.
The system updates the auction records according to the applied changes and refreshes the display to reflect the new state.
If the Auctioneer selects 'Export to Excel', the system generates and downloads a spreadsheet file containing the details of the currently displayed or selected auctions.
If the Auctioneer selects 'Create New Auction' from the action panel, the system navigates to the 'Create New Auctions Page' instead of modifying existing auctions.

If the Auctioneer applies a profile (e.g., 'Strawberry Default') via the 'Apply Profile to Selected Items' panel, the system overwrites the Duration, Starts, and Ends fields for the selected auctions with the profile's predefined values.
If the Auctioneer attempts to apply manual reserves without selecting any items, the system displays an error message indicating that at least one item must be selected.
If the Auctioneer attempts to apply manual reserves without selecting any items, the system displays an error message indicating that at least one item must be selected.

If the Auctioneer selects 'Create New Auction' from the action panel while on the edit page, the system navigates away to the 'Create New Auctions Page' instead of modifying existing auctions, potentially discarding unsaved edits.
The selected auction records are updated in the system with the new parameters (e.g., Duration, Starts, Ends, Manual Reserves) or are removed from the scheduled list.
The 'View / Edit Scheduled Auctions' page refreshes to display the current state of the inventory, reflecting any edits or removals made by the Auctioneer.
If an export was performed, a spreadsheet file containing the auction details is generated and available for download.
